authority: Finite gate registry. Add a new gate only when materially necessary evidence reveals a genuinely new completion requirement.

gates.title: GitHub Persistent Project State bootstrap
acceptance_criteria: PROJECT_STATE.json, CANON.md, and GATES.json exist under parking-remaster-v1/project-state/.
Old chat-handoff rules no longer conflict with GitHub-as-authority.
A new Chat can determine current gate, canonical constraints, gate counts, latest verified evidence, and exact resume action from GitHub alone.
evidence: Migration requested 2026-09-20; repository structure audited before mutation.

gates.title: Product thesis, benchmark, and visual authority
acceptance_criteria: Parking Jam / Car Out / Tap Away style successful gameplay is the benchmark family.
Approved VISUAL MASTER is locked as the only production visual authority.
Target is iPhone-first HTML5 with immediate understandable play.

gates.title: Reusable visual production foundation
acceptance_criteria: Production clean plate is approved and hash locked.
Ten MASTER-derived reusable production car sprites are approved and hash locked.
Old patch/reveal visual runtime dependency is retired.

gates.title: Level Data, solver, and runtime parity foundation
acceptance_criteria: Level Data is the gameplay source of truth.
Python solver and JavaScript functional core agree on legal state transitions for published content.
Solver validity is not misrepresented as proof of human fun or difficulty.
evidence: Legacy Level 1 1024-state parity PASS; legacy Level 2 512-state parity PASS.

gates.title: Legacy Level 1/2 technical runtime proof
acceptance_criteria: Instant Start, progression, restart, production assets, and runtime plumbing were technically demonstrated.
Result is explicitly classified as technical evidence only, not core-gameplay approval.
evidence: REAL_DEVICE_GAMEPLAY_REJECTION_20260919.md later rejects the gameplay design while preserving useful infrastructure.

gates.title: Real-device core gameplay rejection and rebuild decision
acceptance_criteria: Old hidden blocker + shared curved exit gameplay is rejected.
Level 3 authoring remains locked.
Core gameplay rebuild must make visible geometry, legal movement, and physical movement agree.
evidence: Fresh-player test on rejected gameplay explicitly deferred.

gates.title: Single-car motion and skid-feel proof through V7.2
acceptance_criteria: Two-stage charge/blast/snap/reload/exit cadence feels substantially better on physical iPhone.
Rear snap is rear-dominant and does not pre-turn during straight launch.
Snap tire marks render as smooth per-wheel arcs rather than polygonal frame segments.
evidence: User evaluation reached '動きはだいぶ良い'.
V7_2_RESULT.json: duration about 1715ms; one smooth snap stroke per rear wheel; 8 contact points each.

gates.title: V7.3 engine roar + tire squeal user feel review
acceptance_criteria: On physical iPhone, engine reads as a car rev/growl rather than Famicom/tonal synthetic audio.
Rear snap has an obvious tire squeal / friction sound.
No regression to accepted motion/skid behavior.
evidence: Browser proof run 35491534202 SUCCESS; duration 1708.9ms; snap strokes 1/1; contact points 8/8; AudioContext running.
gates.blocker: Requires user's physical-iPhone listening judgment. Recording is optional unless diagnosis is needed.

gates.title: Single-car core-fun acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Motion, sound, responsiveness, and immediate feedback jointly feel satisfying on physical iPhone.
The accepted single-car interaction becomes the reference motion/audio grammar for rebuilding visible multi-car gameplay.

gates.title: Visible multi-car movement-rule prototype
acceptance_criteria: Legal/illegal movement is inferable from visible board geometry.
Actual car movement follows the same visible rule used by logic/solver.
No repeated long passive wait and no hidden-ray/shared-Bezier mismatch.
Only one small prototype is built before restoring a full level.
gates.blocker: P1-007 must pass. Multi-car expansion is forbidden before single-car feel is accepted.

gates.title: Rebuilt Level 1 target-iPhone core-fun proof
acceptance_criteria: Instant Start remains intact.
Fresh player can infer first useful action without explanation.
Visible multi-car rule is satisfying and legible on target iPhone.
Level 1 logic and physical motion are solver/runtime-parity compatible.

gates.title: 14-level representative Vertical Slice
acceptance_criteria: 12 Main + 2 optional Hard levels exist from controlled Level Data authoring.
All 14 are solver-proven, visually reviewed, and Beat-Chart compliant.
Difficulty forms the canonical deliberate waveform.
Failure/retry mechanic is visible, fair, deterministic, and immediate.
gates.blocker: P1-009 must pass. Production has not started.

gates.title: Vertical Slice fresh-player greenlight
acceptance_criteria: Fresh external players progress without developer explanation.
Failure cause is understood; retry is immediate; continuation desire is demonstrated.
Target quality and per-level production cost are repeatable and bounded.
evidence: VERTICAL_SLICE_GATE_V1.md defines GREENLIGHT / REWORK / PIVOT-KILL outcomes.

gates.title: Content factory repeatability proof
acceptance_criteria: Level schema, solver, difficulty features, duplicate detection, Level Library, Beat Chart, regression QA, telemetry specification, and rollback manifest work as one repeatable pipeline.
Small batch production demonstrates stable time and quality.

gates.title: 30-level content pilot
acceptance_criteria: 30 Main + representative Hard levels preserve difficulty wave, variety, retry behavior, and production quality.
Internal/external playtest does not reveal repetition or pacing collapse.

gates.title: Closed external playtest
acceptance_criteria: Fresh players validate comprehension, fair failure, retry behavior, remembered satisfaction, and continued play without coaching.

gates.title: Controlled release / soft launch
acceptance_criteria: Real distribution evidence supports core loop, progression, pacing, stability, session behavior, and repeat play.

gates.title: Validated 144-level content production
acceptance_criteria: 120 Main + 24 optional Hard levels are produced only after controlled-release evidence justifies scale.
Every published level is solver-proven, Beat-Chart compliant, duplicate-screened, visually reviewed, and deliberately placed.

gates.title: Release candidate and launch
acceptance_criteria: Target-device QA, full content integrity, persistence/recovery, performance, distribution compliance, permitted metrics, rollback build, launch assets, and required privacy/legal checks pass.
